text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
――It's all over, Scarlet-chan. 
The closing dance… and the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey… do you think our vow will reach 
across this sky? 
Do you think it reached the place where 
that voice came from?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will. 
It has to.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, tonight is the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
A festival for horse girls and humans 
alike.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
――It's a special festival to celebrate our 
bonds 
with the people who cherish us horse 
girls, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(that I will always be someone 
worthy of the “name” I bear.)
